title: Borsuk Partition Problem in Dimensions Four Through Sixty-Three
exact_target: For each $4\leq d\leq 63$, determine whether every bounded set $S\subseteq\mathbb R^d$ can be partitioned into at most $d+1$ subsets of diameter strictly smaller than $\operatorname{diam}(S)$.
